title: EndlessSketch Help
intro: This reference describes the current tools and settings. Setting changes apply immediately and are saved automatically in local/settings.json beside the application.

items.name: Brush (B)
items.description: Draws an opaque line with the selected color and size. A single click creates a dot.

items.name: Eraser (E)
items.description: In vector mode, subtracts its stroke from existing Paint lines on the active visible/unlocked layer inside Depth capture. Targets are fixed on pointer down, an empty gesture adds no history, and one Undo restores the whole result. It shares Brush size; Fill and CompactBlock are not affected yet.

items.name: Area Fill (L / X)
items.description: Trace an area. On release, the contour closes automatically and is saved as a vector fill. L enters Fill directly; X enters Area Fill from other tools.

items.name: Eyedropper (I)
items.description: Samples the rendered topmost visible color under the pointer and makes it the current Brush color. Alt + left tap samples color without changing the current tool or adding history.

items.name: Selection (S / Q)
items.description: S opens Selection; repeated S in Object mode cycles Inside/Crossing without clearing the current Object selection. Q opens Selection from other tools, and repeated Q while Selection is active switches Object/Area.

items.name: Area Fill / Erase (X)
items.description: Press X once to activate Area Fill, then press X again to cycle Area Fill and Area Erase. In vector mode, Area Erase subtracts its closed area from existing Paint lines on the active visible/unlocked layer inside Depth capture. Targets are fixed on pointer down, an empty area adds no history, and one Undo restores the whole result. Fill and CompactBlock are not affected yet. Press Esc to cancel an unfinished contour.

items.name: Straight line
items.description: Shift + left-drag draws a straight Brush or Eraser line from the starting point to the pointer.

items.name: Change size
items.description: Ctrl + left-drag vertically changes the Brush, Eraser, or Fill size without drawing. Size is also available in the top toolbar.

items.name: Brush / Fill right-click
items.description: With Brush or Fill active, right-click the canvas to open the current RGB color and shared Size at the pointer. They use the same Palette and toolbar state; editing the menu creates no stroke, lasso, or history step.

items.name: Color and transparency
items.description: Palette is a movable and resizable window for the current RGB color. The picker width follows the window width. New objects are opaque. Alpha from older objects remains stored but is flattened over the white background for display.

items.name: Wheel zoom
items.description: The mouse wheel zooms around the pointer position.

items.name: Pen or mouse zoom
items.description: Hold Z and left-drag vertically. The point under the pointer remains the zoom anchor.

items.name: Pan
items.description: Space + left-drag or middle-drag moves the view horizontally and vertically.

items.name: Jump to depth
items.description: Open Navigation, enter a depth from -10000 to 10000, and press Go or Enter. The visible center is preserved at the new depth.

items.name: Tile X/Y jump
items.description: Navigation moves to absolute tile coordinates at the current depth. Large integers and notation such as 1e100 are accepted. Full coordinates can be selected and copied; Origin returns to tile 0/0.

items.name: Exact return
items.description: Create a bookmark before an extreme depth or coordinate jump when you need a reliable return point.

items.name: Select one object
items.description: Click an object with S. Only objects on the active visible unlocked layer are eligible.

items.name: Inside / Crossing
items.description: Inside selects only objects fully enclosed by the rectangle. Crossing also selects lines and fills touched by it.

items.name: Area selection
items.description: Switch Selection to Area, then choose Rectangle or Lasso. The released contour stays on the canvas and follows pan, zoom, and depth navigation. It clips newly committed Brush, Eraser, Fill, and Eraser Lasso operations, while the Area contour itself remains temporary UI state and is not saved to document history.

items.name: Add or remove
items.description: Shift + click adds an object. Ctrl + click toggles it.

items.name: Cycle overlapping objects
items.description: Alt + wheel cycles objects under the pointer. With a stylus, Alt + vertical drag in Object Selection cycles them too: down selects the next object, up selects the previous object. Alt + left tap remains temporary color picking.

items.name: Move
items.description: Drag any selected object. The complete selection moves together and is saved as one undoable command on release.

items.name: Uniform scale
items.description: Drag one of the four square corners of the shared bounds without modifiers. Objects scale around the opposite corner; release saves one undoable command, while Escape cancels the preview.

items.name: Rotate and flip
items.description: Drag the round handle above the shared bounds to rotate around the center; hold Shift for 15-degree snapping. Flip Horizontal and Flip Vertical in the Selection menu mirror the selected objects around the bounds center. These commands keep vectors editable and save one undoable replacement command.

items.name: Recolor selected
items.description: Applies the current opaque RGB color to selected Paint and Fill objects as one undoable replacement command. Erase and EraseArea objects stay unchanged, and the selection remains on the new recolored copies.

items.name: Freeze/Compact selected
items.description: Packs the selected Object set on the active visible unlocked layer into one CompactBlock operation, including separated objects and existing compact blocks. The block stores a vector snapshot, not a bitmap. Rendering expands its sources back into the global paint order, while editing treats the block as one optimized object: it can be selected, moved, scaled, rotated, flipped, copied, pasted, moved to another layer, and compacted again with other objects.

items.name: Right-click Selection menu
items.description: With Selection active, right-click the canvas to open the same Object/Area, Inside/Crossing, Rectangle/Lasso, Deselect, Cut, Copy, Paste, Paste in place, Delete, Flip, Recolor, and Freeze/Compact commands at the pointer. Opening it keeps the selection and does not start a box, move, scale, or rotate gesture.

items.name: Order within a layer
items.description: Ctrl + wheel moves selected objects one paint-order step relative to neighboring objects on the active layer.

items.name: Clear selection
items.description: Press Esc or use Deselect. Object selection, Area selection, and unfinished selection gestures are cleared without changing document history.

items.name: Current selection limit
items.description: Object rectangles select whole vector objects and do not crop them at their boundary. Area selection clips new Brush and Eraser centerlines plus Fill and Eraser Lasso polygons at commit time; exact full stroke-boundary handling remains a later checkpoint.

items.name: Copy / Cut
items.description: Ctrl+C copies selected objects to the document-local clipboard. Ctrl+X copies and removes them as one undoable command.

items.name: Paste
items.description: Ctrl+V pastes into the active layer with a 16 px offset. Each additional paste increases the offset by another 16 px.

items.name: Paste in place
items.description: Ctrl+Shift+V pastes at the original coordinates. Pasted objects receive new identifiers and remain selected.

items.name: Delete
items.description: Delete removes selected objects as one command. Source data remains in history for Undo.

items.name: Undo
items.description: Ctrl+Z undoes the latest drawing, object edit, or supported layer command.

items.name: Redo
items.description: Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redoes an undone command. History remains available after closing and reopening the document.

items.name: Active layer
items.description: New objects are created only on the active layer. Object Selection searches only that layer.

items.name: Depth capture
items.description: Depth capture ±N in Layers limits Object Selection to the complete native-depth span around the current camera depth. Auto is enabled by default and follows Vector depth radius. With Auto off, the manual radius cannot exceed the vector radius. A mixed-depth CompactBlock is selected only as a whole; changing the effective radius or crossing a depth boundary clears the current Object Selection.

items.name: Visibility and lock
items.description: The first checkbox hides a layer; the second prevents edits. A hidden or locked active layer rejects drawing and selection.

items.name: Create and reorder
items.description: The + button creates a new top layer. Up and Down change the active layer's render order.

items.name: Duplicate / Delete / Rename
items.description: Duplicate copies a layer and its objects. Delete removes a layer after confirmation when nonempty. The final layer cannot be deleted. Rename changes its name.

items.name: Move selection to
items.description: Transfers selected objects to another visible unlocked layer as one command.

items.name: Merge Down
items.description: Combines the active layer with the nearest lower visible unlocked layer. Undo restores both layers.

items.name: Bookmarks
items.description: The Bookmarks button in Navigation opens bookmarks. Add stores the current camera under the entered name. Open returns to it, Rename changes the name, and Delete removes it.

items.name: Profile
items.description: Performance, Balanced, and Quality change most speed/quality settings together, including Vector depth radius (1/2/4). With Depth capture Auto enabled, its effective radius follows that value; with Auto off, the manual radius remains independent within the vector boundary. Custom appears after any managed field is edited. Distant tiles, Auto itself, manual Pause tile generation, Cache size, Display, logging, and Keep latest objects remain independent.

items.name: Brush input px
items.description: Minimum distance between accepted Brush and Eraser points. A smaller value follows fast movement more accurately but stores more points, increasing document size and processing load. A larger value stores fewer points but can lose small turns. This is not smoothing strength.

items.name: Fill input px
items.description: Minimum distance between accepted Fill contour points. A smaller value records a fast contour more accurately but creates more points and load. A larger value makes lighter contours but may miss small bends.

items.name: Fill fallback points
items.description: Maximum point count for the derived temporary vector fallback of a saved Fill while its tile is missing. Lower values improve UI performance and make the temporary fallback coarser without changing the saved raw contour.

items.name: Fill fallback depth
items.description: Maximum camera-depth difference for temporary vector Fill display. Lower values reduce distant-view load, but fills wait for tiles more often.

items.name: Stroke fallback joins
items.description: Controls saved-stroke joins in temporary no-tile vector fallback. Auto preserves capsule joins and saved smoothing for short sparse saved strokes while viewing, but uses a fast one-shape raw polyline path without endpoint caps during active drawing or tile waiting. Quality keeps capsule joins longer. Performance always uses the fast raw one-shape path. On overloaded no-tile scenes, a frame budget can temporarily downgrade extra segmented runs to the fast path to avoid crashes or memory spikes. Stored document points and PNG tiles do not change.

items.name: Saved fallback ops
items.description: Limit for temporary no-tile saved vector fallback. 0 means Unlimited and paints every visible saved operation. Values above 0 paint only the newest N operations until tiles are ready, improving dense-depth speed while older drawing can temporarily disappear without tiles. Performance sets 1500; Balanced and Quality set Unlimited.

items.name: Zoom settle ms
items.description: Delay after the last zoom event before high-quality tile work begins. A larger value avoids wasted work during movement but makes sharp tiles appear later.

items.name: Tile workers
items.description: Number of background tile-rendering threads. More workers rebuild faster on a powerful CPU but compete more strongly with the UI and other applications.

items.name: Distant tiles
items.description: Uses the existing whole-scene PNG tile when a non-empty viewport has no nearby editable operation on the active visible/unlocked layer. Other visible layers are included in the tile but do not keep vector mode active. Empty views create no tile jobs. In distant_tile mode Selection, Eraser, and Area Erase are read-only; Brush and Fill remain available and return the view to vectors after commit.

items.name: Vector depth radius
items.description: Camera-relative radius ±N for vector display. If the complete native-depth span of an editable operation on the active visible/unlocked layer fits the radius, the whole viewport is vectors_near and cached PNG is not mixed in. CompactBlock stays atomic. Range 0–32; default ±2. Performance/Balanced/Quality set 1/2/4.

items.name: Tile resolution
items.description: Physical PNG size of each tile. 64–256 px is faster and smaller but looks more pixelated. 512 px is the normal balance. 1024–2048 px adds detail at higher CPU, memory, disk, and upload cost.

items.name: Pause tile generation
items.description: Stops all new PNG tile work. Drawing, vector saves, Undo/Redo, and backups continue. Distant views use vector fallback while paused; nearby views are always vector-rendered.

items.name: Pause tile generation while drawing
items.description: Temporarily frees CPU from tile generation only during the current stroke. Work resumes on release and does not override the manual persistent pause.

items.name: Deferred drawing preview
items.description: A mode for slower CPUs. Pointer points are collected while drawing, but the growing draft is not rendered; the completed stroke appears on release. This reduces current-gesture cost but does not accelerate existing content.

items.name: Rebuild policy
items.description: Immediate requests missing tiles at once. After interaction waits for a short idle period, reducing competition with the UI but updating tiles later.

items.name: Prefetch tiles
items.description: Number of tile rings prepared around the screen. 0 reduces background work. 2 can make later panning smoother at higher CPU, disk, and memory cost.

items.name: Edge quality
items.description: Edge quality in PNG tiles. Performance is faster with more visible steps. Balanced is the normal mode. Quality produces cleaner edges with slower rebuilds. Saved vectors do not change.

items.name: Smoothing
items.description: Display smoothing for Brush, Eraser, and Fill geometry. Off shows raw points. Light, Balanced, and Strong progressively remove more jitter and round corners. Stored document points do not change.

items.name: Cache size MiB
items.description: Disk PNG-cache budget for the current document. Older tiles are removed after the limit is exceeded and are rebuilt when needed. Drawing data is never deleted.

items.name: PNG compression
items.description: Fast uses less CPU and writes larger files. Balanced is a compromise. Small compresses more and writes more slowly. Pixel quality is unchanged.

items.name: Storage commit
items.description: SQLite commit durability for the current document. Full keeps the previous synchronous=FULL behavior and is safest against OS or power loss. Fast uses synchronous=NORMAL to reduce heavy commit stalls, with weaker protection for the latest commits during system failure. Performance sets Fast; Balanced and Quality keep Full.

items.name: Preview FPS
items.description: Background refresh rate for drafts and tile waiting. Lower values reduce continuous load but may look less smooth. Direct pen and mouse events still request frames immediately.

items.name: Keep latest objects
items.description: Controls manual old-object compaction. Unlimited disables the Compact older now button. Keep 5000, Keep 1000, and Keep 100 leave the newest top-level objects editable. Compact older now packs older editable-layer objects only as contiguous layer/depth/paint-order runs. Rendering expands CompactBlock sources into the global paint order so visible stacking is preserved.

items.name: Display: Show canvas overlay
items.description: Master switch for text drawn over the canvas. Disabling it hides the overlay completely but does not change the document, camera, tiles, or drawing performance.

items.name: Display: Overlay profile
items.description: Minimal shows only zoom and status. Standard also shows operation count, FPS, and active tile state. Diagnostics enables every field, including depth and coordinates. Manual changes produce Custom.

items.name: Display: individual fields
items.description: Depth, Zoom, Tile X/Y, Local X/Y, Operation count, FPS / frame time, Status, and Tile / rebuild state can be enabled independently. Full extreme coordinates remain available in Navigation.

items.name: Diagnostics: Session logging
items.description: Writes JSON Lines session logs to local/logs/session-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.jsonl. Basic is the default. Off disables session writes. Detailed adds extra navigation-generation detail. Slow frames include tile phases plus saved fallback projection, derived smoothing/sampling, clipping, shape-paint timings, and saved fallback cache hit/miss counters. The app keeps the newest 20 session logs.

items.name: Diagnostics: Mark log
items.description: Writes a manual marker to the current session log. F12 does the same and the status shows Log marker #N. When reporting FPS or zoom issues, send the marker number, what you did near it, and the .jsonl file.

items.name: Reset
items.description: Restores all settings to their defaults and saves them immediately.

items.name: New / Open
items.description: New creates a directory-based .esketch document. Open selects an existing .esketch directory. File shows the current path.

items.name: Authoritative data
items.description: Vector operations in canvas.sqlite3 are the original drawing data. PNG files under cache are only acceleration copies and can be rebuilt.

items.name: Autosave and backups
items.description: A draft is saved during a long stroke. The database is checkpointed periodically, and verified rotating backups are kept inside the document.

items.name: Translation files
items.description: Help loads help/*.json beside endless-sketch.exe. You can edit a translation or add a JSON file with a unique id; its language tab appears after restarting.

items.name: F1
items.description: Opens this Help tab unless a text or numeric field is being edited.
